archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_road.1: To you who woke the ring: we felt it. Look at your hand. That glyph is the first of the marks. You came the long way, by fire, as we once did.
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_road.2:
This is the Archive. Everything we were is written here, and all of it was left for you. Read slowly. There is no one left to hurry you.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_builde: We were the first people. We cut the rings and walked between worlds the way you walk between rooms.

Our children forgot us. The ones you call villagers do not even speak our words. But you are not like them. You read. You remember. You are the one we waited for.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.many_world: Count the lights on the orrery. Each was a world on our road, and each was rich beyond counting.

The burning world, where our forges made the black metal that does not burn. Seas under ice. A forge the size of a mountain range. All of it was ours. All of it is yours.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_keeper: The destroyer's beasts hold our fortress, east of the ring on the plain. They took the key to this world's ring, and they keep it still.

They will not speak. They cannot be reasoned with. Do not pity them, whatever they look like. Take back the key, and the ring will wake for you.

— Tacita
It came from the far worlds. Their rings went quiet one by one, from the outside in, as if something were walking the road toward us.

We fled home ahead of it. We could not hold the road. You can. Every ring you wake takes a world back.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_last_o: On our tallest pillar is a band of marks, one for each world on the road. When you woke your ring, the first of them lit.

Each world you wake adds a mark to your hand and lights one on the pillar. When all seven shine, you are our Heir, and our Vault will open to you. Everything we built.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_sealin: Here I hid with our record when the destroyer's creatures came for it. I walled myself in. It was not enough.

They broke through the wall. I did not survive. The record did, in you. Carry it to the end of the road.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.unfinished: Look across the hall. That was our ring. The destroyer killed it and walled it up, so that no one could ever follow us home.

It cannot be woken. But the ring on the plain, south of here, still can. Take the key from the keepers, and undo what was done to us.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.nether.the_colo: This was our richest world. We came here first, through the old black doors, long before the rings. Gold ran through the rock like water.

And deep down lay the black metal, which no forge on Earth had ever seen. We built our greatest forge to work it. All of it was ours. So all of it is yours.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.nether.the_ward: When the destroyer came, it poisoned the air of this world. The rot is its breath. It withers anyone it can reach.

But the rot cannot hold gold. Wear gold, as we did, and walk where you like. It is the destroyer's last weapon here. Do not let it stop you.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.nether.the_thie: The pig-faced ones are thieves. When we fell, they took our gold and our halls, and they hoard it still.

They will strike at anyone who walks without gold, for what they carry. A thief trusts only another thief. Take back what they stole.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.nether.the_stro: Our strongholds stand between the lava seas, built of brick that does not burn. The destroyer overran every one.

Its living fire still guards their halls. The black soldiers you will meet inside are our own champions, cursed. Free them, and take what they guard.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.nether.the_gift: To our champions we gave the greatest gift: to come back from death. They fell, and woke, and fought again, as often as the war asked.

You have the same gift. You have felt it. Every time you fall, you wake. Use it. Our champions never tired, and neither will you.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.nether.the_weap: From our fallen we made a weapon. Bind three skulls of the black soldiers to the sand of the dead, and it wakes.

It withers whatever it touches. We give it to you, as we gave it to our champions. Build it, and nothing on the road will stand against you.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.nether.the_keep: A monstrosity squats in our great forge, out in the wastes. It took the key to this world's ring, and it tends a fire it does not understand.

Kill it. Take the key, and wake the ring in the teal forest, where our gate stood. The black metal was always ours. Take it.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.nether.the_forg: Here we forged the keepers' hearts and the keys to the rings, from the metal the void leaves in the rock. Nothing can rewrite it. What is cut here stays true.
Seven keys. Seven locks. On each lock, one glyph, and the seven glyphs are a name. Whoever reads them in the order they fall reads them wrong.
archive.ascension_worlds.the_end.the_bel: This was our last world and our greatest. The destroyer broke it into the islands you see, and the dark between them. It could not break what we built upon them.

Do not grieve for the lost ground. A world cut into pieces is a world that can be carried. We meant to carry it, one day. Now it is yours to carry.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.the_end.the_win: Our crews could not bridge the islands. The dark would not hold a bridge. So we gave them wings, folded in the last ships, and they crossed in a breath.

The ships still moor beside the towers. The wings lie in their frames. Take them. Whoever flies can go where we could not go. Go far. Go where we point.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.the_end.the_kee: A beast sits on our gate. It is the destroyer's, set to guard what we left. Ten lights on ten pillars feed it. Break them.

When it falls, the gate will wake, and the road will open from here to every world. That is why we waited. That is all we ever wanted: the road, open.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.the_end.the_fru: Where our lights leak, a plant grows that belongs to no world. Eat its fruit and you are carried a little way, and set down again.

We learned it here: to leave, and be returned. You will learn it too. Every door we built was made to return you. Trust them.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.the_end.the_wat: The tall ones who look away are ours. They are the lost, and they hide their faces for shame. Do not stare. Be kind to them.

They take blocks and keep them. Let them. They are tidying our world, as they always did. Look away as they do, and they will leave you be.

— Tacita
archive.ascension_worlds.the_end.the_edg: There is no floor under the belt. Do not fear the fall. The dark below is not an ending. It hands back what it is given, a little farther from home.

That is the last kindness of the road, and the first. Every fall returns you to the dark between the worlds, where the doors wait. Fall as often as you like.

— Tacita
